title: Resolution urging Albany to fund fatherhood support programs
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, legislation establishing a Center for Fatherhood Initiatives under the state Office of Children and Family Services. The center would issue grants to organizations statewide to run programs supporting fathers, including co-parenting, non-custodial, incarcerated and teen fathers. It reflects companion state bills S8892A and A9811.
